reports.remarks: Uprooted trees and limbs snapped along Dinco Rd near Superior Rd.

A brief, narrow EF0 tornado caused damage mainly to trees along Upper Service Road in Greene and Raccoon Townships. Max wind was estimated at 75 mph, and path width was roughly 50 yd. The tornado began in a wooded area south of Service Creek and appears to have ended before Gibbs Rd.
